title: SURE memory merged index
description: sure/memory/index.json (memory design spec 6.4): confirmed + legacy entries from references/ plus provisional entries from sure/memory/provisional/, rebuilt by index.py. match.ts reads only this file and treats an unknown schema value as a corrupt index. sources_sha256 is the sha256 over every source file's relative path + content sha, sorted by path; index.py --check rebuilds only when it changes. Documentation only.

omitted_provisional.description: provisional rows left out of index.md by the line / byte budget

hash_mismatch.description: entry ids left out of the index because entry.md no longer matches meta.entry_sha256; reported by index.py --check on stderr and by cli rebuild-index. Absent in index.json files written before this key existed.

component.description: unit id, '_' , or null for a headerless legacy entry

trigger.description: empty for headerless legacy entries (they never match in hooks)

hook_trigger.description: subset of trigger used by hook injection: meta.hook_trigger when present (bad_case: triggers seen in the run digest at publish), else trigger

title.description: H1 of the entry file; the only text hooks inject

path.description: repo-relative path of the entry file
